payload.title: File:Puertasaurus Skeletal V2.svg
payload.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
payload.description_html:
Skeletal restoration of Puertasaurus. The holotype, MPM 10002, consists of a cervical vertebra, a dorsal vertebra, and two unfigured caudal vertebrae. Missing elements were restored after Patagotitan, Futalognkosaurus, Notocolossus, and Tapuiasaurus. The human silhouette is from File:Silhouette of man standing and facing forward.svg (CC0). The total length of the sauropod is approximately 30 meters in this reconstruction, although the extremely incomplete nature of this taxon makes any size estimate exceedingly tenuous.
